body:
Related #24. Exact head 477057aadc9bc8e757bc8ef817125377e816d212, base c89c12df. 21 new host files. Pure Normal/analog control session: HELLO/CAPS/CONFIG/ARM/STOP, explicit partial/zero write progress, response deadlines after final write, provisional sequence before first accepted byte, strict RX replay/order, early ABORT cancellation and fail-closed recovery. No serial/USB, GUI, sample assembly or continuous RELEASE loop. Command deadlines stay here; sample-progress deadline belongs to the window receiver, with downstream fault hook.

Pinned shared draft b6ae8025; newer c54 external-ID-only clarification is noted, not silently adopted. Author 31 + independent 39 = 70 session tests pass normally and under Python -O; full Linux host suite 211 passes with zero skips. Exact source/evidence hashes, transcript and initial failed expectations retained. No independent Critic-B verdict yet, no Windows/device/common-contract acceptance; A retains merge authority. Old host baseline will receive reviewed core fixes during integration, not via hidden acceptance transfer.
title: DRAFT HOST-006: bounded control-session lifecycle
